ephemeris: DE440 short planetary SPK; paired with DE440 lunar orientation PCK and DE440/DE421-compatible ME frame

observer.location_status: provisional tile-centre test point, not verified lander coordinates
observer.vertical_reference: Assumes DEM Z is radial height above the 1,737,400 m reference sphere; verify against the complete PGDA product README.

product: Site01 provisional Sun and geometric Earth visibility timeline

terrain_horizon.azimuth_interpolation: linear circular interpolation between 0.1-degree bin centres
terrain_horizon.source: multi-resolution 5 m local + 80 m regional horizon CSVs
terrain_horizon.status: regional lower bound; terrain beyond 45 km can raise the true horizon

time_system: UTC input parsed by CSPICE STR2ET; ET/TDB seconds past J2000 stored per row

visibility_method.disk_fraction: analytic circular-disk clipping against a locally straight terrain horizon at the disk-centre azimuth
visibility_method.earth: geometric Earth disk visibility; not a communications link or DSN availability calculation
visibility_method.geometry: SPICE Moon-centred target vectors translated to the surface observer in the lunar ME frame
visibility_method.sun: geometric solar disk visibility; not solar-panel power
visibility_method.surface_normal: radial normal of the spherical reference surface; local DEM slope is not applied
